subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Describes the mass of water-filled bags or tins: heavy, light, heaviest, lightest

show.line: Heavy and light! A full bucket of water is heavy. An empty bucket is light.

rounds.praise: Yes! A full bucket is heavy.

rounds.prompt: Which one is light? Easy to lift.
Look at the elephant. Is it heavy or light?
Heavy or light? Put each thing in its group.
Three tins. Which one is the heaviest? The biggest full one.
rounds.praise: Yes! The big full tin is the heaviest.

rounds.prompt: Which bag is the lightest? It has the least inside.
rounds.praise: Yes! The empty bag is the lightest.

hints: Heavy things are hard to lift. Light things are easy.
Full is heavy. Empty is light.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will lift the heavy one.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: This feather is so heavy! I cannot lift it.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! A feather is light. A brick is heavy.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's think together. A feather floats. It is light!

parent_line: Can say which things are heavy and which are light.
